## What it is

The tower at 180°, the left side. Recessed 2. Four clips on a 1 m strip, one quarter turn after the start tower.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side.
- The foot is the same 6.0 × 3.2 mm tab as the other towers. The 2 is recessed into the top face of the rib.
- The spoke is 6 mm along the tower and crosses the whole 6 mm rib. A 45° gusset, 3 mm on a side, is added at the outer face.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up.
- Don't swap it with number 1. The tab fits every slot. The clips would no longer be one helix.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-08: first 180° tower.
- 2026-11-08: notches and lug replaced by a recessed 2.
- 2026-11-08: spoke widened to the rib and a 45° gusset added at the tower.
